summary: Wilson Pateras is an award-winning firm founded in 2009 with offices in Melbourne, Bendigo, Geelong and Sydney; Watson Erskine & Co joined in October 2025. Mark Forte has been Principal since April 2015 after 16 years as a partner at McLean Delmo Bentleys.

claims.text: Wilson Pateras is an award-winning accounting firm founded in 2009, based in Melbourne, Bendigo, Geelong and Sydney.
claims.quote: Wilson Pateras are an award-winning accounting firm based in Melbourne, Bendigo, Geelong and Sydney.

claims.text: Its Melbourne office is at Level 1, 678 Victoria Street, Richmond.
Mark Forte is Principal of Wilson Pateras Accountants & Advisors, in the role since April 2015.
Mark spent 16 years as a partner at McLean Delmo Bentleys before joining Wilson Pateras, advising small to medium businesses.
claims.quote: Business Sevices Partner servicing small to medium size businesses in sectors including manufacturing, retail, construction, medical industry

claims.text: In October 2025 Watson Erskine & Co joined Wilson Pateras, forming Wilson Pateras Sydney CBD.
claims.quote: We are delighted to announce that Watson Erskine & Co have joined Wilson Pateras.

claims.text: Wilson Pateras was named Accounting Firm of the Year, Australia Wide, by Accountants Daily in 2019.
claims.quote: Accounting Firm of the Year, Australia Wide, by Accountants Daily in 2019

claims.text: In an October 2018 blog Mark Forte explained how Wilson Pateras bookkeeping and Virtual CFO services help barristers, noting clients often use Xero or MYOB but report incorrectly.
claims.quote: Many will make use of intelligent accounting software – such as Xero or MYOB – but often report incorrectly.

claims.text: Wilson Pateras offers its bookkeeping service on a fixed fee or monthly fee, including payroll management and reporting.
claims.quote: Our Bookkeeping service is available on a fixed fee on a deliverable basis or on a monthly fee.

claims.text: Wilson Pateras services include taxation, business advice, lending, financial planning and SMSF management.
claims.quote: taxation, business advice, lending, financial planning and Self Managed Super Fund (SMSF) management
